info.title: id-proto-debugger API
info.description:
The id-proto-debugger api: a guarded proxy and relay for the protocol
workflows a browser cannot complete on its own. Every endpoint that
connects anywhere does so to a target its caller names, under the address
policy, timeouts and caps of the api's configuration.

get.description:
Fetch an identity provider's SAML metadata server-side, because the
descriptor endpoint sends no CORS headers. The URL is the caller's, under
the address policy, timeouts and caps.

scheme is checked after decoding.

body as text.

ModelRefusal.description:
The validator's own refusal: the body was not the JSON shape this
operation takes. `code` is always EMODELREQUEST, and `error` names the
member and what was wrong with it.

Refusal.description:
A request this service refused, or a call it could not complete. `error`
is a sentence for a person; `code`, where the endpoint has one, is the
stable name a caller branches on.

relayState.description: art:<id>. Expires with the exchange stash.

Saml.ArtifactContext.description: The handle to carry in RelayState (or SAML 1.1's TARGET).

arsUrl.description:
The Artifact Resolution Service (2.0) or SAML responder (1.1). Fetched
later, by the landing, under the address policy.

privateKeyPem.description: Signs the resolution request when present; unsigned when not.

sigAlg.x-checked-in-code: common/xmldsig.js: checked when the resolution request is signed; a failure is the landing's 500

samlVersion.description: "1.1" for a SAML 1.1 responder; anything else is SAML 2.0.
samlVersion.x-checked-in-code: api/server.js: exactly "1.1" selects SAML 1.1; every other value is 2.0

Saml.ArtifactContextRequest.description:
What resolving an artifact will need, registered before the request goes
out. The key is optional (neither version requires the resolution request
to be signed); the address is not.

responseXml.description: The decoded protocol message (or a WS-Federation wresult verbatim).

relayState.description: The RelayState, TARGET or wctx that came back with it. Empty if none.

Saml.Exchange.description: A stashed exchange. The SAML and WS-Federation landings share one.

SAMLResponse.description: POST binding: base64 XML. Redirect binding: DEFLATE then base64.

RelayState.description: SAML 2.0's relay state, returned byte for byte.
RelayState.x-checked-in-code: api/server.js: must be a string, else 400 text/plain ACS: invalid RelayState. (also TARGET's)

TARGET.description: SAML 1.1's relay state, read when RelayState is absent.

SAMLart.description: An artifact, resolved over the SOAP back-channel.
SAMLart.x-checked-in-code: api/server.js: resolved with the context RelayState names (art:<id>); no context, no Response or a failed call is a 500

Saml.Landing.description:
What an identity provider sends, in a form or a query string. Nothing
here is refused by the schema: see the head of this file.

privateKeyPem.description: The service provider's RSA private key, PEM. Never stored.

binding.description: post, artifact, or anything else for the HTTP-Redirect binding.
binding.x-checked-in-code: api/server.js: post and artifact are named; every other value, and none, is the redirect binding

sigAlg.description: The SignatureMethod URI. Absent is rsa-sha256.
sigAlg.x-checked-in-code: common/xmldsig.js: rsaSigAlgRefusal() — an RSA method this signer implements (400 samlsign: SignatureMethod … is not an RSA method …)

destination.description: The identity provider's endpoint. Absent: only the query string.

certPem.description: A certificate for KeyInfo, PEM. Absent: no KeyInfo.

relayState.description: Sent as written. The artifact binding replaces it with its handle.

rootElement.description: AuthnRequest or LogoutRequest. Read, and changes nothing.

arsUrl.description: The artifact binding only: the Artifact Resolution Service's URL.

spEntityId.description: The artifact binding only: the <Issuer> of the ArtifactResolve.

Saml.SignRequest.description: Sign a request for the binding it is sent on.

Saml.SignedPost.description: The HTTP-POST binding: the form the browser auto-submits.

location.description: destination + the query string, or the query string alone.

Saml.SignedRedirect.description: The HTTP-Redirect binding: a signed query string.

enabled.description: Only a truthy value adds the headers.

to.description: wsa:To. Empty is the ARS URL.

messageId.description: wsa:MessageID. Empty is a fresh urn:uuid.

Saml.WsAddressing.description: WS-Addressing headers for the artifact back-channel's SOAP envelope.

Service.ModelGap.description:
One answer that did not match its operation's response schema. Recorded
only where `validateResponses` is on, which is a test configuration; the
answer itself was sent unchanged. No member value is recorded, only where
the schema and the answer disagreed, because an answer can carry a token.

Service.ModelGaps.description: Every recorded gap since the process started.

wa.description: wsignin1.0, wsignout1.0, wsignoutcleanup1.0. Echoed on a sign-out.

wresult.description: The RequestSecurityTokenResponse, raw XML. Absent is a sign-out.

wctx.description: The context the relying party sent, returned as written.

WsFed.Landing.description: What the identity provider sends, in a form or a query string.

url.x-checked-in-code: api/server.js: an absolute http(s) URL (400, url must be an absolute http(s) URL.); the address is the outbound agent's

soap.description: The SOAP envelope, sent as written.

soapVersion.description:
"1.1" (text/xml and a SOAPAction header) or anything else for SOAP 1.2
(the action inside application/soap+xml). Compared after String(), so
the number 1.1 is SOAP 1.1 too. Absent is 1.2.
soapVersion.x-checked-in-code: api/server.js: String(soapVersion) === "1.1" is SOAP 1.1; everything else is 1.2

action.description: The WS-Addressing action, into SOAPAction or the content type.

sslValidate.description:
Only false, or the text "false" (a form sends text), turns certificate
verification off.

body.description: Its body as text: an RSTR, an RSTRC or a SOAP Fault.

WsTrust.StsAnswer.description: What the STS answered, whatever its status.

servers.description: The api's own origin. Embedded, it is the debugger's origin + /api.
